article.title: At the Fruit Shop
article.content: Ben goes to a small fruit shop with his mother. They need fruit for lunch. Ben likes red apples, but his mother wants bananas too. They buy four apples and six bananas. The apples cost two pounds and the bananas cost one pound. Ben carries the apples in his blue bag. His mother carries the bananas. At home, they wash the apples and put all the fruit on the kitchen table.
article.translation: 本和妈妈去一家小水果店。他们需要为午餐买水果。本喜欢红苹果，但妈妈也想要香蕉。他们买了四个苹果和六根香蕉。苹果共两英镑，香蕉共一英镑。本用蓝色袋子装苹果，妈妈拿香蕉。到家后，他们洗了苹果，把所有水果放在厨房桌上。

questions.prompt: How many bananas do they buy?
questions.explanation: 文中说“four apples and six bananas”，不要把苹果的数量当成香蕉的数量。

questions.prompt: How much do they pay for all the fruit?
questions.explanation: 苹果两英镑，加上香蕉一英镑，一共三英镑。
“Ben carries the apples in his blue bag”给出了答案。
